ownership.fact: Simulator::cCreatureGameData owns current brain level and evolution points; the additive mutation also writes cPlayer.mCurrentGoalProgress.
Simulator::cMission owns the active MissionState and cMissionManager owns saved tutorial and tracked-mission state.
Simulator::Cell::cCellSerializableData owns the Cell progression snapshot and first-editor-entry milestone.
Simulator::cCollectableItems owns unlock configuration, per-item status, per-level unlock counts, unlock points, and unlocked-item membership.
App::cGameModeManager owns the registered mode vector and active index; Editors::cEditor separately owns its internal Build, Paint, and Play mode.
Simulator::cBadgeManager owns badge state, stage state, and event counters; Simulator::cPlayer owns stage consequence traits and social/combat progress.
Simulator::cHerd owns herd DNA-evolution state; Simulator::cNpcTribeController owns the baby-growth timer map.

state_variable_invariants: AddEvolutionPoints accepts signed input; only zero is an explicit no-op and only the stored point balance is capped.
cPlayer.mCurrentGoalProgress receives the requested delta, which can differ from the clamped evolution-point delta.
GetEvoPointsToNextBrainLevel returns zero for every level outside 0 through 3.
SetEvolutionPoints is a raw assignment and does not run AddEvolutionPoints side effects.
MissionState value 4 is absent from the SDK enum.
cMission.SetState clears display/title state on every state write and only the Active entry is documented to emit kMsgMissionUpdate.
Cell progression fields form a persistence snapshot, not a recovered finite gameplay-state enum.
Collectable registration, unlock, highlight, and NotUnlockable status are distinct concepts.
A mission tool key is not equivalent to an mUnlockableTools inventory entry until the unresolved reward writer runs.
App game mode and Editors::cEditor internal mode are separate state machines.
No transition in this domain has positive original-runtime evidence.
